name: AeroPack Minimalist Waterproof Commuter Backpack (22L)
description: Engineered for urban commuters and digital nomads, the AeroPack 22L combines weatherproof 900D recycled ballistic nylon with a suspended 16-inch padded laptop vault. Sleek, lightweight, and built to withstand monsoon downpours without sacrificing minimalist style.
features: IPX5 water-resistant recycled ballistic nylon exterior with sealed YKK AquaGuard zippers
Dedicated suspended fleece-lined sleeve fits up to 16-inch MacBook Pro / laptops
Hidden anti-theft passport pocket and luggage pass-through strap
Breathable ergonomic EVA foam back panel for all-day comfort
22-liter capacity weighing just 780 grams

name: SoundCore Pro ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
description: Immerse yourself in studio-grade audio with hybrid active noise cancellation that blocks up to 95% of ambient office and flight noise. Featuring custom 40mm bio-cellulose drivers and 50-hour battery life.
features: Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation with Transparency Mode
50-hour battery life with 5-minute USB-C fast charge (4 hours playback)
Multipoint Bluetooth 5.4 pairing for seamless laptop-to-phone switching
Plush memory-foam protein leather earcups for fatigue-free listening
Built-in 4-mic AI beamforming array for crystal-clear calls

name: KeyCraft K2 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard (75% Layout)
description: Compact 75% aluminum-frame wireless mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable tactile brown switches, per-key white backlighting, and dual Mac/Windows keycaps for effortless productivity.
features: Hot-swappable PCB compatible with 3-pin and 5-pin mechanical switches
Connect up to 3 devices via Bluetooth 5.1 or wired USB-C
CNC-machined aircraft-grade aluminum frame with acoustic dampening foam
4000mAh rechargeable battery lasting up to 3 weeks per charge
Includes dedicated keycaps for both macOS and Windows layouts

name: BrewMaster Precision Pour-Over Coffee Kettle (800ml)
description: Craft barista-level pour-over coffee at home with a surgical-grade 304 stainless steel gooseneck kettle. Engineered for slow, steady, pinpoint water flow control and compatible with induction and gas stovetops.
features: Precision 8mm gooseneck spout for controlled, turbulence-free pouring
Food-grade 304 brushed stainless steel body with built-in lid thermometer
Ergonomic counter-balanced heat-resistant handle
Works on induction, ceramic, electric, and gas cooktops
800ml capacity ideal for 2 to 4 cups of specialty coffee

name: ErgoLift Aluminum Laptop Stand (Foldable)

Non-slip silicone pads protect laptop chassis from scratches

Folds completely flat with included felt carrying sleeve

name: StrideFlow Lightweight Running & Gym Sneakers
description: Responsive nitrogen-infused midsole cushioning paired with an engineered breathable knit upper for daily 5K runs, gym sessions, and all-day walking comfort.
features: High-rebound EVA foam midsole absorbs impact on concrete roads
